info.name: Examination Session Dashboard APIs
info.description:
Dashboard APIs for examination progress UI.

Base path: `/examinationSession`

1. Planning Overview — stepper stages (Planning → Evaluation)
2. Timeline — published exam schedules (Today's Timeline)
3. Progress Metrics — operational health, digitization, evaluation, examScheduleId-wise details

request.description:
GET /examinationSession/planningOverview?examinationSessionId=

Session-level progress only (no exams array). Calculates per exam then averages:
1. roomsAssigned 2. invigilators 3. bundles READY+ 4. hallTickets 5. answerSheets scanned+marked 6. results published

Response: percentage, totalExams, stages{}.

GET /examinationSession/timeline?examinationSessionId=

Fetches all exam_schedule rows for the session (with exam_schedule_room_capacity rooms), ordered by examDate ASC, examTime ASC.

capacity / studentCount = booked student_exam_seat count for that examSchedule (not room capacity).

GET /examinationSession/progressMetrics?examinationSessionId=

Session-level only (no examSchedules array):
- operations — rooms vs bundles READY+; hallTickets generated for seated students
- digitization — students (mapped answer sheets), scanned (fileUploadId), marked (markingStatus=submit or evaluatedAt); percentage = scanned/students
